identity_marker: silver rectangular Fi GPS module and blue merle Australian Shepherd
continuity_anchors: brightly lit room with a rustic wooden table and soft natural daylight
video_goal: Demonstrate how to assemble, fit, and pair a Fi GPS collar on an Australian Shepherd.
single_prompt: A top-down view reveals a brightly lit room with a rustic wooden table and soft natural daylight where hands place a silver rectangular Fi GPS module and a heavy-duty nylon collar band side-by-side. The camera moves to a close-up as hands pick up the components and slide the metal end-link of the collar band into the side groove of the module. In an extreme close-up, thumbs press firmly down on the metal link until it snaps flush into the casing. Transitioning to a medium shot, a fluffy blue merle Australian Shepherd sits patiently while hands present the fully assembled Fi collar. From an over-the-shoulder view, hands part the thick fur around the dog's neck and wrap the nylon collar band around it. A close-up shows hands pushing the two ends of the plastic quick-release buckle together until they snap shut. Two fingers then slide between the collar band and the dog's neck, lifting slightly to show a large gap indicating it is too loose. Hands unbuckle the collar, slide the plastic tri-glide adjuster to shorten the nylon band, and re-buckle it around the dog's neck. Two fingers slide snugly between the collar and the dog's neck, demonstrating a proper fit beneath the thick fur. From an over-the-shoulder view, one hand holds a smartphone displaying the Fi app interface, while the index finger taps the 'Activate Collar' button. A screen capture shows a spinning loading circle transitioning into a large green checkmark. Finally, in a close-up, the LED light on the silver Fi GPS module resting on the Australian Shepherd's neck flashes blue, confirming the active connection.
